retrieved.title: 采访布光：单一柔光主光

request:
镜头 s14：纪录片采访镜头，时长 8 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-int78）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', '50mm']）：Locked look "2078 oral-history interview" (style preset sp01-int78): a Sony FX6 on a locked tripod; S-Cinetone; a 50mm prime at f/2.8; filter Black Pro-Mist 1/8; grade: neutral, gently warm skin, background one to two stops under the face; light: one large soft key 45 degrees from frame left, negative fill on the right, a small warm practical in the background; texture: clean, fine detail, real skin texture; a calm, restrained oral-history interview, the subject looking past the lens.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary talking-head interview, tripod camera, subject looks past the lens at the interviewer
导演意图（自然语言）：采访固定机位，近景。波爷低着头，苦笑了一下，说完把目光移开。环境声：安静房间的底噪。
情绪：remorseful, quiet, honest
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, locked-off interview camera
景深与虚实：Very shallow depth of field, only his eyes and glasses sharp.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Oral-history interview close-up: Boye, 64, in the dim concrete room, glasses back on, looking down and to the side with a faint rueful smile. Blocking lock: Boye's face fills frame centre-right, looking down toward frame left; dim soft background.
Picture 2: Boye, 'Grandpa Bo' (61, male, old network protocol engineer) (character reference; role: the mentor). A 61-year-old Chinese man, retired network protocol engineer who now runs a repair stall. Short grey-white beard, thinning grey hair, black-framed glasses with one temple wrapped in tape, deep wrinkles, gentle stubborn expression. Faded dark navy quilted cotton jacket over a brown knitted vest, a soldering-stained apron.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Boye (old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse) — 波爷（六十多岁老人的声音，缓慢、沙哑）: 大家都笑了。我也笑了。
现场环境声：quiet room tone
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-interview] 机位：采访固定机位
[ours/sound-room] 声音：采访间底噪
[rules/move/locked-off] move
[ours/light-interview-key] 采访布光：单一柔光主光
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

16:9 horizontal, single clip 8.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2078 oral-history interview" (style preset sp01-int78): a Sony FX6 on a locked tripod; S-Cinetone; a 50mm prime at f/2.8; filter Black Pro-Mist 1/8; grade: neutral, gently warm skin, background one to two stops under the face; light: one large soft key 45 degrees from frame left, negative fill on the right, a small warm practical in the background; texture: clean, fine detail, real skin texture; a calm, restrained oral-history interview, the subject looking past the lens; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, close-up, locked-off tripod interview camera with no movement at all from start to end framing; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Boye's face fills frame centre-right at the start, tilted down toward frame left, the dim concrete wall soft behind him and the small warm practical glowing far back over his right shoulder. Start: he is looking down, eyes low behind the black-framed glasses, the taped temple catching a thin line of key light, the corners of his mouth beginning to lift into a faint, tired, rueful smile. Middle: he draws a slow breath, lifts his chin a little and speaks, the smile tightening and then loosening as the words come out, his beard moving slightly with his jaw, one hand shifting out of frame below with a small rustle of the quilted jacket. End: the smile fades, he turns his gaze away from the lens toward frame left, eyes going distant and quiet, and holds that averted look with his mouth settling closed. Mood: remorseful, quiet, honest. Blur: very shallow depth of field; only his eyes and the glasses are sharp, the ears, the back of the jaw, the shoulder of the navy quilted jacket and the concrete wall falling softly out of focus. Boye (old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse) says, <d>[Chinese] 大家都笑了。我也笑了。</d>; Final line of this shot: end on "我也笑了", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.
